description: The measured strategy seeds TradeAssi house bots start from — no api_key required (optional key attributes the call). Each seed is a screener template × timeframe × side that cleared the public recommendation bar; entries include condition_groups for create_strategy, variation ranges, and the backtest gate. Workflow: list_strategy_seeds → create_strategy (seed_key) → submit_for_verification → get_verification_status.

min_n.description: Only seeds with at least this many measured detections at the horizon (drops static seeds)

side.description: Only long or only short seeds

template_id.description: Only seeds of this screener template id

timeframe.description: Only seeds measured on this timeframe (e.g. 1h, 4h, 1d)

name: list_strategy_seeds
title: List Strategy Seeds
